person_made_it: Built for the people who love Gordon but cannot fly to Palm Springs: a room of their own, then the weekend game.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Darby, welcoming faraway friends and saying plainly what happens to their wish.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Desert night: lanterns, a 56 in the stars, a long table of glowing empty chairs.
did_the_click_pay_me: Hold-to-light lantern flies up and stays in his sky; 12 stars draw a heart; clink with bubbles; wheel lands a word; all with sound when on.
works_for_the_recipient: No login, phone first at 390, 44px targets, 14px text, sound off by default, reduced motion respected, wish has a copy fallback.
taught_me_something: Twelve true things Gordon gives the people he loves: GGP, USC, Pride, convening, joy.
told_me_the_truth: No venues, times, friends' messages or crew names; wish copy promises only that Darby collects them and gives them to Gordon on his birthday.
weakest: Wishes rely on FormSubmit; if the mailbox is not activated or down, friends get the copy fallback instead.
